question: Which honour did Gandhiji return in protest of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaiser-i-Hind**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kaiser-i-Hind was a medal awarded by the British government in India for public service.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi was awarded the Kaiser-i-Hind in 1915 for his contributions to public welfare.
 
• In 1920, Gandhiji returned the Kaiser-i-Hind medal as a gesture of protest against the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
 
• This act of returning the medal was a significant move in Gandhiji's non-cooperation movement against the British colonial rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre**

 
 
• The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on April 13, 1919, in Amritsar, Punjab.
